methodology.effectiveSize: lexicalCodeLines counts lines containing PHP tokens outside comments/whitespace and includes complete multiline string literals; physicalLines includes configuration data and inline HTML.
limits: Lightweight lexical scan, not a validating parser.

migration.note: Readiness is an explicitly recorded acceptance result, not inferred from static inventory or file counts. This command does not rerun behavioral tests.
